title: AI and Formula 1: Redefining Speed and Strategy with Intelligent Technology
description: AI is used in Formula 1 for race strategy, simulation, telemetry, predictive analytics, and decisions made under ridiculous time pressure.
short_description: A practical look at AI in race strategy, simulation, telemetry, and split-second decisions, without pretending the software drives the car.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in Formula 1, including operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
